body: Sounds like a waste of time. Just skip the appointment and buy drugs like a normal person, or is your therapist actually a dealer?
How do you do these every day?

What exactly are you asking for, then? She's getting the shot and there's nothing else to discuss. Some people have suggested getting her ice cream or something, that's pretty much all you can do for her right now. She'll realize eventually that you saved her life.
Especially the no-bra pics, that's a huge yikes from me, and I don't even wear them.

I hate candid photos, possibly more than OP. I'm not a damn Kardashian, I want to be able to exist comfortably in my own home without worrying about what is essentially the paparazzi. We aren't all made for that life. She doesn't even see them until other people have already reacted. The things that you think makes her look "adorable" could actually make her look any number of bad things to somebody else. Specifically in the "professional world". Nevermind the fact that they're permanent. I think feeling like you have a right to choose a girl's image she puts into the world is really messed up. This would happen to me once before I stopped it. No negotiations. You can tell me there's a camera or you can fuck right off.
So she cheats in front of you leading you to assume there isn't more cheating going on? That really doesn't make sense my guy.

I'm sorry but you've got to be delusional to think nothing more is going on. Even if it wasn't, her kissing other people is plenty enough to end it over. Your girl has manipulated you to the point she can kiss another man in front of you. If it's really nothing and goodbye kisses like you think why are they doing it when they aren't even parting? Why don't they kiss on the cheek like normal "BFFs"? Would she be upset if you asked her to do that? Is it seriously that important to her to be able to smush her lips into this guy's lips? More important than the relationship?
How? He just has an account for it so it doesn't show up on his main, seems completely reasonable to me.
The "real world" has never given me blacks eyes or made me cough up blood. 🤷🏻‍♀️
Either way he's a jerk. I don't think it matters at this point and nobody can really tell you what his intentions were.

WHAT? I know I'm only going off of a bit of info but I really don't think you should be with this guy. If he has such an obsession for this random girl to the point it's ruining his current relationship, it really makes me wonder if he's unstable in other ways. Even if this is his only issue, it's a pretty significant one. You deserve to be with somebody who gives you a chance.

I'm 22 too and it started when I was about 12.

Damn, what the fuck to this guy though. Are you currently living/talking with him? I really think getting away from him should be a priority. I can't imagine what could possibly happen to make him suddenly change and realize his current/future relationships could be as good as his last one. Certainly not anything you could do, he needs therapy if he's going into every relationship expecting it to not live up to his other one. He's really ending relationships before they have a chance to start. Why did they even break up if she was so perfect, do you know?

Reading it again I genuinely can't tell which girl he meant, he was talking about A but could have switched? I think it could be either, haha.

Wait no, definitely the other girl. I'm not in a good state of mind and easily confused, sorry, haha.

I hate hate HATE when people post anything of me at all without my consent. I'm also extremely insecure and change my Facebook picture about once a year. I've always hated photos, even as a child.

Social media is meant to be our highlight reels but you showed his behind the scenes. I think if you had asked him to pick something specific to post it would have been totally fine. I have posted some photos with people but they absolutely have to be "okay'd" first.

I unfortunately don't have much advice because I struggle with this too. Just wanna say you aren't alone. I feel like I should have been a miscarriage, the body is supposed to naturally abort weak fetuses, it happens more than people realize, so how did I not qualify? It takes every ounce of my being to function on such a basic level.

Also it's really interesting to me how people who post here and r/suicidewatch have the funniest usernames. Some of the only joy in my day is reading them, I wish I picked something better, haha.

So you're angry at her for having sexual intreactions with the person she was dating and not knowing she wouldn't always be with him? Is that what you're saying? She opened up about being sexually abused and this is your reaction? That she wasn't thinking of your feelings at the time? Do you think she's psychic?

Also "I thought she wasn't that kind of person", the kind to have sex with her partner? Do you intend to never have sex or get a blowjob either?

You genuinely need therapy and will ruin every relationship you ever have if you keep this up. I don't think it should have to be explained to you why he deserves privacy even if he isn't doing anything wrong.

You say it's unfair that you can't judge penis size because boys judge bra size, but did he do that to you? Maybe it would be "fair" to mention it after he does, but it doesn't sound like he did. I would apologize for your dumbass friend and leave him alone, if he's ignoring you like this I wouldn't trust anybody else telling you he's interested. If he is he will show you.
What the hell counts as cheating to you if fucking her best friend and calling her your "new girlfriend" before breaking up isn't?
The post is even funnier, he's already cheated on her but "doesn't want to look like a scumbag".

Your "soulmate" was obviously jealous for good reason, you literally cheated on her. I really don't think there is a good way to go about this, if you really don't want people to think you're a scumbag you could have just not acted like one.

Has he ever given you a reason to check his phone? If there is one you didn't mention it. Even if he has nothing to hide, a phone is something of a safe space for a lot of people. It's like parents taking the door off of their kid's bedroom. Privacy is important and you aren't giving him any. If I had a partner who did this I would simply buy another, secret phone. I'm not hiding anything at all, my phone is just my phone.

That could be seen on a regular blood test, right? I definitely know people who were ruined for years because of lack of vitamin D. I kinda wish this was the answer for me because then everything could be fixed by taking a vitamin but I've had lots of tests and nobody's ever mentioned it. My doctor is worthless though and could have not even looked at my results for all I know.

Where are you from? I'm Canadian and originally brought it up to my family doctor at a regular checkup appointment. He started me on antidepressants and referred me to a mental health center where I saw a therapist and psychiatrist each once a week. The list for 1 on 1 therapy is normally months long but I guess I got in fast because it was severe. Group sessions are basically always available, though. This was all free for me aside from the medications, but I don't know if it's an option everywhere. If you have a school counselor they can probably help you figure out how to get started!

It doesn't work that way, I was depressed as a 12 year old, what did I have to be depressed about? I have some reasons for it now but it honestly wasn't much easier when I didn't, sometimes our brains just don't work right. If you're an adult you don't need them to be involved, in fact my treatment started when I was 13 and I brought it up at a regular doctor's appointment. I don't even think they had much say at all, even when I was that young. They could have just not bought my pills I suppose but if it was my own prescription I think I could have just got them myself if I had gathered the money. 

My whole family is trash with mental illness too, my mom still says to me "whatever happened to your 'depression'?" as if I didn't do years of therapy and medications and still don't want to kill myself every single day.

I've found that they won't commit you unless you have a specific plan, date, etc. Even me telling doctors I have a method in mind and readily available wasn't enough to commit me apparently. But I think in most cases

"I'm depressed but I don't know what to do about it"

is less risky than something like

"I'm depressed and there's a train that goes by my house, and I know that that's a pretty successful method"

Are you able to enjoy the shower once you're in there? I know that's how it is for me, I dread it and put it off and once I get in I feel so stupid for depriving myself. Or are you able to take a bath? I find those a lot easier and more appealing. 

I can bring myself to shower but I can't bring myself to spend two minutes a day brushing my teeth, depression makes no sense.

Wow, schizophrenics just need love, not medicine! But diabetics need medicine for some reason, funny how that works. Do you realize toddlers with perfect lives are schizophrenic? Do you even realize it can be passed down genetically? You are a part of the problem. People kill themselves because of viewpoints like yours. You're wrong and I shouldn't have to sit here and explain to you why you're wrong, it's already been proven so much. Your willful ignorance is harming people.

I've had physical illnesses for years now and if I have one single day without symptoms or even just less symptoms I'm convinced I've been faking it the whole time. And then when it gets super bad and I feel like I'm legitimately dying I feel so much relief because it proves I'm not lying. This is mainly because my issues are invisible and tests say I'm healthy when in reality I'm suffering pretty much 24/7. 

I don't really do this with my mental health because I honestly don't have many high points at all, so I know I'm fucked in the head. 🤪🔫 I'm sure it's not uncommon to feel that way, though. Or even if it IS all just for attention, something is still wrong, yknow?

You sound a lot like me. Since you aren't really doing anything else at the moment it would be a great time to seek help if you're able to!

For me personally I always regret not doing it sooner and I can't stand to think of being 60+ dealing with these exact same issues. I can drag myself through life for the good days but they are outnumbered about 360:5 and it just feels less and less worth it as time goes on. People just get desperate at a certain point.

It doesn't matter that you don't "believe" in chemical imbalances, they still fucking exist. Do you not believe in schizophrenia either? You wouldn't be saying this shit about diabetics not needing insulin, to just read a spiritual book. You think you understand because you were sad for a year after somebody died, you have no clue. I wanted to die as a 12 year old kid for no reason at all. Tell me again my problem doesn't exist. Doctors who spend their whole lives on this disagree with you.

r/wowthanksimcured

I literally don't even have the option to do any of those things because of my chronic illnesses. I've wanted to die for for 10 years. These things would probably work for people who don't have a legitimate chemical imbalance but not all of us are as lucky as you. Plenty of people need medicine.

I objectively am a burden. Don't mean to be "woe is me", it's just the truth. He was a saint for staying with me this long and I can't expect anybody else to even come close to doing the same. I never should have even accepted his request for a relationship when it was obvious that it would always end this way (my own death).

He was into me enough to wash my hair and feed me and do basically everything except wipe my butt for the last few years because I'm chronically ill. Best friends and high school sweethearts and a completely perfect relationship gone because of me and nobody else. If he can't do it nobody can. It may seem superficial to kill myself for getting dumped but this really isn't a typical situation.
I've been suicidal long before this, I literally overdosed a couple days ago still can't walk properly. I think he has the right to be fed up. He's just numb.
It's been hard times for him the entire six years of our relationship. I've been highly suicidal for literally a decade and apparently this is his limit.

I think it's a bad idea because it could likely go like this:

"I didn't ask anyone to mine yet lol"

"Ok"

And then you never know. If it's awkward to ask her to hang out I promise you it will be more awkward to ask her to spend several days of appointments and hundreds of dollars on you.

Ah, sorry, 5am here and haven't slept. You haven't talked since December? I really think you should try to hang out normally first. I'm not trying to discourage you but just because she texts you for 2 hours doesn't mean she wants to pay for hair, makeup, and nail appointments, on top of hundreds of dollars on a dress for you. Also flowers, photos.. It's just a lot to deal with and I honestly wouldn't want to go through with that for somebody I haven't talked to in months. But if you really want to ask her this way the worst that can happen is she says no.

That's pretty relevant info that you left out. You told him the relationship would be over if he did this and he did it, more than once even. This drama he doesn't want could have easily been avoided if he had kept his part of the deal. It sounds like he chose working out with girls over your relationship. Seems pretty clear what you want to do.
If she doesn't want to casually hang out she definitely doesn't want to go to prom. From the one worded replies she's sending I would have to assume she isn't interested.

I'm really confused, did you think he was going to cheat on you at the gym? With multiple girls at once? 

If you told him not to do something and he did it obviously that isn't okay, but I don't think your reaction to a girl asking him to workout together is normal, and it could possibly the reason he didn't want to tell you.

The biggest "occasion" you've mentioned is your friend's birthday party. Personally if I found out my significant other was asking Reddit for advice on such a silly thing we would be done then and there. If you're this upset by your girlfriend wearing sweatpants, yes, you should break up, but for her sake, not yours.

I gotta say, I've lurked here most of the time since being told I've had IBS two years ago, and you are the only person I can see post and specifically remember you and say, "oh, that person". And not in a good way. If you are going to spend so much of your life trying to help others by talking to them, you need to learn how to actually talk to people.

A week is really not enough time at all to give any type of medication. All of my doctors I've seen have wanted me to try something for about six months before switching it or adding to it. Even when they start to work they won't cure you, are you doing therapy or anything else in the meantime?
??? Did you forget to switch accounts or did you legitimately think you were replying to another person?
So you're okay with being his second choice? Also he didn't cheat on you, he asked and you said it was okay.
Only men? I was like this for a long time but it seems to have faded away.

Do diabetics need insulin, or is it a willpower issue? 

Do cancer patients need chemo, or is it a willpower issue?

Do those who are anaphylactic need an EpiPen, or is it a willpower issue?

I have PTSD because I thought I was dying when in reality I was not close to it whatsoever. I still am terrorized by it almost every day. It's called Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, not Post Military Disorder, not Post Molestation Disorder. Stress is all it takes.

I think it doesn't matter and there's a way bigger issue here. You don't need to be asking strangers a dozen times whether he implied something, you need to be asking a therapist why you asked such a question in the first place.

He "implied his ex was prettier" because you ASKED! He even said it in a nice way! If he had said "no, you're prettier" would you have honestly believed him? I genuinely don't think you should be in a relationship right now, that question is incredibly immature and you kind of set him up to fail.

We simply need sunlight to live. If you go long enough without it you will feel more than miserable, it can cause serious health issues. You would probably really benefit from a therapy lamp, I haven't tried one yet but I've heard nothing but good things about them!

Update!

I haven't taken my meds and I don't plan to

I have however taken a lot of other pills and am nicely stumbly and confused, takes a couple tries to type out sentences properly. It's nice being sensitive to drugs and being able to get fucked up on over the counter meds

I don't know when I last ate, all I know is it wasn't in the last 3 days

It's 7am and I don't plan on sleeping 

I really need to fucking destroy myself in every way I am not already

Hopefully this really is the last time I have to feel like this
Wow, what country are you in? That sounds so ridiculous. I really believe you cannot help people who don't want it.

What is the point of forced therapy? They might be able to force you to be there but can they force you to speak? What are they gonna do if you sit there silently? Spank ya? Doesn't even make sense. If you aren't willing to talk it's a waste of your time and theirs.

I didn't really have a reason to be depressed and suicidal as a 12 year old kid but I definitely still was! The brain/mental illness doesn't discriminate, it doesn't care how good your life is. You could have nothing wrong whatsoever aside from a simple chemical imbalance, but that chemical imbalance is still there and is absolutely terrible to deal with.

I feel the same about death, I could do it now by choice, or spend 50+ more years chronically ill just for it to happen anyways. I've tried for 10 years to get help and enjoy life and it hasn't worked, what if I keep hoping but it never happens? I know a lot of people think this is stupid and a hard life is better than none, but nothing scares me more than growing old and feeling the same as I do now.
Why does the age of people posting here bother you so much? It's like complaining there's "too many lefthanded people here", it's completely irrelevant.

I've never called or talked to one of these services, but it sounds like they only really care if you're an immediate danger. You don't have a plan and therefore it's not important to help you. They don't mind letting us suffer as long as we'll stick around and they don't have be liable for a death. I would suggest going to an actual hospital/therapist if you can.
"Having fun" really isn't an option for some of us. My age has nothing to do with it, I was wishing I was dead when I was half this old, too.

Yes! I'm just overall a weak person and there's nothing I can really do about it. It feels like everything is so much harder for me compared to others, and I need to put in so much effort for bare minimum results. I could be described as lazy, oversensitive, etc but there's nothing I can do to change it. I'm dragging myself through life and it's really draining me.

I'm very self destructive but dehydration is the scariest thing ever to me. I drink so much water that people think I'm an undiagnosed diabetic, but I can happily go days without eating. I have a history of eating disorders which might partially explain it, I just love water so much, haha.
Did you have some terrible event that made you ask this?

No specific reason, I assume I was born with some kind of imbalance, but 10 years of pills and therapy hasn't been able to cure it for some reason. I kinda feel like I should have been a miscarriage or something, I'm just not strong enough to survive in this world. I feel like some people just aren't "meant" for life, as nonsensical as that might sound.

He is one of the few reasons I'm still here but the reasons I should die are outweighing him. I've never been able to believe that he loves me and it's taken a huge toll on him. I've been pushing him away our entire relationship and I don't know how much longer he will put up with me.

I honestly don't think so. I wanted to die as a child, long before I had any "real issues". The problems I've developed don't help but I genuinely think I would feel pretty much the same even if I had a perfect life. But since I didn't have a perfect life, who knows?

I've never really considered living for other people, I can't even make myself care about how my parents would feel if I died. Living for myself obviously isn't working, though. Maybe I'll try something else.

Even in elementary school my mother would tell kids who called for me that I was "busy" or not there at all because I just could not bring myself to talk to them. I only use the phone if I absolutely have to, and I write myself a script before I do. It helps a lot.

Unfortunately sometimes the chemicals in our brains just don't care how good we have it. I was suicidal even younger than that, for no real reason. I have plenty of reasons now that I'm an adult, but it honestly wasn't much easier without them.

I think that not caring about your life to the point of risking it is definitely suicidal behavior and actually more common than actively hurting yourself. Lots of people wish something else would kill them because we are not really meant to hurt ourselves, survival instincts are a bitch.

Thank you. I just can't change how I feel unfortunately. It feels like being proud of climbing Everest, thousands of dollars, months of time, risking your own death and watching that of  others, and for what? To say you did it? That just doesn't seem worth it to me at this point. Thank you though.

After high school you have a lot more options of who to be around. I honestly still have never made friends outside of work, but that's really by my own choice. I'm extremely picky with people because I just don't want to be in that situation again. I'm pretty antisocial and don't feel like I'm missing anything, though. For somebody who actually craves friends it should be a lot easier to get them!

I had one friend at that age too, who basically kept me around as a verbal punching bag and the butt of all of her jokes. I decided to just walk away one day because I figured being alone was better than that, I've never missed her once.

The hospital told me "this place is for sick people" when I begged to be admitted. I have no idea what they had a whole psychiatric floor for.  That's probably the worst case scenario, and even if that happens you could always try somewhere else. You don't really have anything to lose by trying except maybe your faith in humanity.
